description: This PHP source file defines the InstallationDatabaseAPI class, which is a REST API controller responsible for handling database installation requests during the installation process of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract REST controller and implements the handlePost method to trigger creation of the database, handling exceptions and returning appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: InstallationDatabaseAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for handling database installation requests during system setup.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new database, catching InvalidArgumentException and returning error info if needed.
